description: A compact ARM Cortex-M3 board. Legs use the chip's own port-pin names (A0-A15, B0-B15, C13-C15), not Arduino-style numbering.
how_to_use: A0-A7 are the board's ADC1 channels; I2C/SPI/UART can each be remapped in software to more than one physical pin group, so no bus pin is treated as hardware-fixed here the way it is on an AVR board.

plain.what: A small, fast board with a more powerful chip than the Arduino Uno. Popular with more advanced makers.
plain.how: It fits in a breadboard like the Nano. It runs at 3.3 V, and its pins are named after the chip (A0, B12 …).
